studio.title: To customise in the Studio.
studio.intro: Four objects designed by the workshop, which you customise in 3D and order directly: firm price, free delivery in Switzerland.

lavaux.name: "Lavaux" vase
lavaux.line: A vase from 80 to 240 mm: shape, pattern, up to four color bands.

cartouche.name: "Cartouche" business card
cartouche.line: An 85 × 55 mm business card, your name embossed or engraved.

montagne.name: Mountain
montagne.line: A small mountain for your desk, up to 12 cm tall, colored by altitude, with your name on the plinth.

borne.name: "Borne" name tag
borne.line: A two-color name tag, embossed or engraved, with or without a ring.

file.title: Already have a file?
file.text: STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP: send it, the workshop replies within 48 hours with a quote.

viewer.ready: 3D model ready. Left and right arrow keys rotate it.

cross.title: A vase in your colors?
cross.body: This vase stays exactly as {author} drew it. For a vase in your colors, the Studio offers our own parametric models.
